The curve data is stark: bundle_share 1.0 and top3_share 1.0 mean every early buyer was bundled and the top three hold everything, while top5_buyer_share of 0.994 in the first two minutes confirms the launch was sniped by a few coordinated wallets. The completer_share of 2.87 suggests a single actor took a large slice of the graduation. The sell_to_buy ratio of 0.0018 right after graduation looks like no organic selling, which often means insiders haven't exited yet; the first real sell wave could crater the price. The name, "MetaMask," borrows a famous brand, a common lure for retail. With only 438 SOL of depth, a 46% loss plus 1.4-5.1% fees makes this a skip.
